text:
The dish is an oval bowl, roughly 20 cm across at its long axis. It holds a mound of cubed chicken or tofu on a bed of greens (arugula and spinach) with some broccoli.

For the protein, I estimate about 150 g of cubed chicken breast. At roughly 165 kcal per 100 g, that is about 250 kcal. If it is tofu, the figure would be lower.

For the vegetables, I estimate about 70 g of greens and broccoli, which adds about 25 kcal.

There is no visible dressing, though the chicken may have some oil on it, so I add about 30 kcal for that.

Total mass is about 220 g, and total energy is about 300 kcal.
